# AutoPilot FDE

> Autonomous Forward Deployed Engineer: mines business workflows from
> Slack/WhatsApp chat streams, scores automation potential (APS) via graph
> transition entropy, Monte-Carlo-simulates ROI, and deploys human-gated
> LangGraph agents with audited approvals.

AutoPilot FDE is the deployment-side counterpart of the HostShift benchmark.
It reads what your team actually says, finds the repeatable workflows hiding
in it, prices the automation opportunity in dollars, simulates straight-through
rates before you spend a credit, and emits typed LangGraph state machines whose
critical steps are structurally human-gated.

Connect it to Claude Desktop, Claude Code, OpenAI Codex CLI or Cursor via its
MCP server (stdio **and** streamable HTTP). Fine-tune your own extractor model
on discovered data and serve it back as the enrichment engine.

## Documentation

- [README](README.md): architecture, math model, verified features, security model, API reference
- [One-step install](README.md#-quick-start): `bash install.sh --run` (or `docker compose up --build`)
- [Connect your coding agent](README.md#-connect-your-coding-agent-mcp): per-client MCP configs for Claude/Codex/Cursor
- [Safe tool adapters](backend/deployment/tool_adapters.py): risk-tiered dispatch; external/critical tiers are structural gates
- [Train your own model](docs/FINE-TUNING.md): export JSONL → OpenAI / Together / local LoRA → serve back
- [Deploy to Hugging Face Spaces](docs/DEPLOY-HF-SPACE.md): free hosted MCP endpoint with one-click badge

## Optional

- [Customizing for your organization](README.md#-fine-tuning-it-for-your-organization): keyword tables, economics, safety policy
- [HostShift sibling project](https://github.com/itsoumya-d/hostshift): measures cross-platform portability of LLM-generated UIs (Host-Lock Index)
